summary.text: Todd Patalano is a Democratic state senator from Rhode Island who has represented District 26 since 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Todd Patalano earned a bachelor's degree and a master's degree from Roger Williams University.
His career experience includes working for the Cranston Police Department.
He took office in the State Senate on January 7, 2025, succeeding Frank Lombardi, and advanced from the Democratic primary on September 9, 2026.
